title: Daily Devotional #46
paragraphs: As I read Luke 2 today, I am struck by the incredible events that took place surrounding the birth of Jesus Christ. From the angel's announcement to the shepherds to the prophecies of Simeon and Anna, everything was orchestrated perfectly by You, Lord.

I am amazed at the humility of Jesus' birth, born in a manger, surrounded by animals. This shows that You came to us in the most humble way possible, as a servant to all, setting an example for us to follow.

I am also struck by the obedience and faithfulness of Mary and Joseph. They trusted in Your plan, even when it seemed impossible or difficult. Mary's willingness to be used by You and Joseph's faithfulness in providing and protecting his family are such great examples for us to follow.

Lord, as I reflect on this chapter, I am reminded of Your great love for us. You sent Your Son to save us from our sins and to bring us back to You. Help me to keep my eyes fixed on You, to trust in Your plan for my life, and to serve others with humility and love.
Thank You, Lord, for Your grace and mercy. May Your will be done in my life and in the lives of all those around me.
